**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Date:** March 1, 2025  
**Service:** Laparoscopic Sleeve Gastrectomy (CPT 43775)  
**Decision:** APPROVED

---

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement (≥35 kg/m²):** Met. Current BMI is 47.3 kg/m² based on weight and height measured at time of evaluation (doc-002).

**Obesity-Related Comorbidity:** Met. Medical record documents active obstructive sleep apnea, an obesity-related condition managed in clinic (doc-003).

**Prior Conservative Treatment:** Met. Patient completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Outcome was unsuccessful with minimal weight loss (2 kg net) that was regained after medication discontinuation (doc-004).

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775) is a covered bariatric procedure (order-005).

---

This authorization is valid for 60 days from this letter. Please contact us if you have questions or if the procedure date changes.
